road_plane_description: Approximate quadrilateral on the central roadway between the queued vehicles and the near crosswalk.

units.speed: km/h for display only (demo; not physically calibrated)

notes: DEMO ONLY. The road-plane points are approximate and were selected visually from sample_traffic.mp4. The 3.5 m lane width and 10 m longitudinal distance are assumptions, not measurements. Displayed km/h is the estimated m/s multiplied by 3.6; this does not make the result physically accurate. Measure known ground-plane distances and verify the lane corners before considering a real calibration.
